verdict.rationale: Apple's own docs show macOS ships built-in apps such as Reminders, Messages, Music, Phone and Passwords, plus Shortcuts. That supports the general claim of out-of-the-box utility apps. None of the four apps the story names (calendar, weather, maps, clock) appear anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: any documentation of built-in Calendar, Weather, Maps or Clock apps, and independent or hands-on corroboration that switchers can rely on them.
